influences.name: Andy Warhol
influences.context: Well, I always love Andy Warhol. He was a good friend, and I always loved him and his stuff. His stuff I loved not only because it looks amazing, but it was different than everyone else's and had an idea behind it. To this day I love Warhol, I loved Pop Art more than classic.

influences.name: Kandinsky
influences.context: I do a lot of drawings, more on the abstract side, more like the Kandinsky side.

influences.name: Jonathan Richman / The Modern Lovers
influences.context: Richman's band the Modern Lovers had a formative effect on The Cars: drummer David Robinson teamed up with Ocasek in the mid-'70s after leaving the Modern Lovers.

influences.name: Roy Thomas Baker
influences.context: Roy taught me a lot about handling band personalities. He was an electronics whiz, a sound guy with a classical background for mic-ing the room's sound. He got harmony.

influences.name: Lou Reed
influences.context: My second favorite was Lou Reed.

influences.name: The Beatles
influences.context: he came to my house and sang the Beatles' "Yesterday" in the sweetest voice I ever heard
